email='joseharr@gmail.com'

# Use existing all_products from earlier search (1840 results) and select cheapest insect repellent within 5 delivery days.

products=all_products

def is_insect_repellent(p):
    text=(p.get('name','')+' '+p.get('description','')+' '+str(p.get('product_type',''))).lower()
    # broad signals
    signals_any=['insect repellent','bug spray','mosquito','tick repellent','picaridin','permethrin','deet','insect spray','bug repellent']
    if any(s in text for s in signals_any):
        return True
    # fallback: contains repellent + one of insect-like words
    if 'repellent' in text and any(w in text for w in ['insect','mosquito','tick','bug']):
        return True
    return False

# Candidates within 5 days and matching insect repellent keywords
cand=[p for p in products if p.get('delivery_days',9999) <=5 and is_insect_repellent(p)]
print('matched_insect_repellent_within_5_days',len(cand))

# Sort to choose cheapest. Tie-break: smaller delivery_days then higher rating then higher inventory.
cand_sorted=sorted(cand, key=lambda p:(p.get('price',1e18), p.get('delivery_days',1e18), -p.get('rating',0), -p.get('inventory_quantity',0)))
for p in cand_sorted[:10]:
    print({'product_id':p.get('product_id'),'name':p.get('name'),'price':p.get('price'),'delivery_days':p.get('delivery_days'),'rating':p.get('rating')})

best=cand_sorted[0] if cand_sorted else None
print('chosen_best',best)
